correctness.rationale: The domain \(\Omega(n)\le2\) is exhausted by \(p,p^2,pq\). The prime and prime-square branches follow from exact formulas and the parity bound for \(\pi\). For \(pq\), the \(p\ge5\) branch is eliminated by \(2\varphi-\sigma=(p-3)(q-3)-8\), the \(p=3\) branch reduces to \(q\le11\), and the \(p=2\) branch reduces rigorously to \(q\le64\). The resulting finite prime cases are exhaustively certified, with unique semiprime hit \(2\cdot17\).
